# AfterImage — instructions for coding agents

You are helping a user work with **AfterImage**: a Python library and CLI for synthetic conversational datasets (multi-turn chat, tool calling, structured outputs, personas, RAG-style grounding, export, preference / DPO-style pairs). Requires **Python 3.11+**. PyPI name: `afterimage`. Source: https://github.com/altaidevorg/afterimage

## What you should do first

Install the package for the environment you are using, then fetch the Markdown guides below (raw URLs) before editing code or configs. Use absolute URLs as written.

## Install

Run one of:

- `pip install afterimage`
- `uv add afterimage`

Optional extras (see `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/altaidevorg/afterimage/main/pyproject.toml`): `embeddings-local`, `server`, `training`. Example: `pip install "afterimage[embeddings-local]"`.

Ensure API keys exist in the environment when examples require them (e.g. `GEMINI_API_KEY` for the stock YAML samples).

## CLI you can run or suggest

- `afterimage generate -c examples/configs/basic.yaml`
- `afterimage generate -c <path/to/config.yaml> --dry-run`
- `afterimage export -i <dataset.jsonl> -f sharegpt -f messages` — also `afterimage export --list-formats`
- `afterimage preference -c <config.yaml>`
